```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 6)
```

`make score-history` runs the benchmark pipeline (`workflow/Snakefile`) with the installed prolfqua and appends its scores and step timings to `inst/extdata/score_history.tsv`, one block of rows per prolfqua release. This vignette reads only that table; the current results with ROC curves are in the vignette `Benchmark_results`.

- Scores: AUC, pAUC_10, pAUC_20, AP, pAP_50, pAP_80 on a 0–100 scale, computed with `benchmark_from_file()` from the contrasts of each fit, per contrast and for all contrasts pooled (`all`), for the rankings by `log_fc`, `t_statistic` and `scaled.p_value`
- `tool_version`: the software that fitted the model. Rows of MSstats, proDA and msqrob2 carry their own version, so a change there can come from their release instead of prolfqua's
- Timings: median elapsed seconds of the core prolfqua steps on the IonStar MaxQuant peptides (`workflow/scripts/time_prolfqua_steps.R`)
- The history starts with prolfqua 1.9.0 (commit `f4dfb7f3`, 2026-11-02, before the rOpenSci self-review), rerun with the pipeline from a library holding that release and the prolfquapp of its time (`make score-history-release V=1.9.0 PROLFQUA=f4dfb7f3 PROLFQUAPP=18914707`); its `date` is the date of the prolfqua commit. Each tagged prolfqua release adds a block: install it, then `make score-history`. A release runs every prolfqua method whose facade it has, on every dataset that provides the method's input

```{r readHistory}
history <- utils::read.delim(
  "../inst/extdata/score_history.tsv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  colClasses = c(prolfqua_version = "character", date = "character", tool_version = "character", level = "character")
)
releases <- as.character(sort(unique(package_version(history$prolfqua_version))))
history$prolfqua_version <- factor(history$prolfqua_version, levels = releases)
# MSstats, proDA and msqrob2 (also msqrob2's hurdle model): only their current performance is shown
history$external <- grepl("^(MSstats|msqrob2|proDA)", history$method)
options(knitr.kable.NA = "")

# One row per release, one column per combination of `columns`; a release without that column stays empty
by_release <- function(data, columns) {
  data |>
    tidyr::unite("column", dplyr::all_of(columns), sep = " / ") |>
    dplyr::select(release = prolfqua_version, column, value) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "column", values_from = "value", names_sort = TRUE) |>
    tidyr::complete(release) |>
    dplyr::arrange(release)
}

# HTML table that scrolls sideways when it has many columns
wide_table <- function(table, caption, digits) {
  html <- knitr::kable(
    table,
    format = "html",
    digits = digits,
    format.args = list(nsmall = digits),
    caption = caption,
    table.attr = "class=\"table table-condensed\""
  )
  cat("\n<div style=\"overflow-x: auto;\">\n", html, "\n</div>\n\n", sep = "")
}

release_plot <- function(data, y) {
  ggplot2::ggplot(data, ggplot2::aes(x = prolfqua_version, y = value, colour = method, group = method)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point() +
    ggplot2::geom_line() +
    ggplot2::scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = "prolfqua release", y = y) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw()
}
```

# Releases

```{r releases}
history |>
  dplyr::group_by(prolfqua_version) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    date = max(date),
    datasets = dplyr::n_distinct(dataset),
    methods = dplyr::n_distinct(paste(dataset, method)),
    rows = dplyr::n()
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(caption = "Recorded prolfqua releases.")
```

# Changes between releases

Changes of the prolfqua models from the previous recorded release of the same dataset, method, contrast, score and metric: at least 0.5 points for AUC, pAUC and AP, any change for counts.
`r if (length(releases) < 2) paste0("Only prolfqua ", releases, " is recorded so far; changes appear from the second release on.")`

```{r changes}
thresholds <- c(AUC = 0.5, pAUC_10 = 0.5, pAUC_20 = 0.5, AP = 0.5, pAP_50 = 0.5, pAP_80 = 0.5)
changes <- history |>
  dplyr::filter(!external, metric != "elapsed_s") |>
  dplyr::arrange(prolfqua_version) |>
  dplyr::group_by(dataset, method, contrast, score, metric) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    previous_release = dplyr::lag(as.character(prolfqua_version)),
    previous_tool = dplyr::lag(tool_version),
    previous = dplyr::lag(value)
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(previous_release)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    delta = value - previous,
    threshold = dplyr::coalesce(unname(thresholds[metric]), 0)
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(delta != 0, abs(delta) >= threshold) |>
  dplyr::select(
    release = prolfqua_version, previous_release, dataset, method, contrast, score, metric,
    previous, value, delta, previous_tool, tool_version
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(release, dataset, method, metric, contrast, score)
knitr::kable(changes, digits = 3, caption = paste0(nrow(changes), " changes above the thresholds."))
```

# Ranking of E. coli against human proteins

One table per dataset: one row per model and prolfqua release, columns metric / ranking score (`log_fc`, `t_statistic`, `scaled.p_value`), all contrasts pooled. A model has no row for a release without its facade (`prolfqua_ropecaV2_nested` came with prolfqua 1.9.4). MSstats, proDA and msqrob2 follow at the end of the table, labelled with their version, with their latest recorded scores only: they change with their own releases, not with prolfqua's. The plots show the prolfqua models.

```{r ranking, results = "asis", fig.height = 4}
ranking <- history |>
  dplyr::filter(contrast == "all", metric %in% c("pAUC_10", "AUC")) |>
  dplyr::group_by(dataset, method) |>
  dplyr::filter(!external | as.integer(prolfqua_version) == max(as.integer(prolfqua_version))) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::mutate(model = dplyr::case_when(
    !external ~ method,
    startsWith(tool_version, paste0(method, " ")) ~ tool_version,
    .default = paste0(method, " (", tool_version, ")")
  ))
for (dataset_name in sort(unique(ranking$dataset))) {
  cat("\n\n## ", dataset_name, "\n\n", sep = "")
  scores <- dplyr::filter(ranking, dataset == dataset_name)
  scores |>
    tidyr::unite("column", metric, score, sep = " / ") |>
    dplyr::select(external, model, level, release = prolfqua_version, column, value) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = "column", values_from = "value", names_sort = TRUE) |>
    dplyr::arrange(external, model, release) |>
    dplyr::select(-external) |>
    wide_table(caption = paste0(dataset_name, ": all contrasts pooled."), digits = 1)
  prolfqua_scores <- dplyr::filter(scores, !external, metric == "pAUC_10")
  if (nrow(prolfqua_scores) > 0) {
    print(release_plot(prolfqua_scores, "pAUC_10, all contrasts") + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~score))
  }
}
```

# Timings

Median elapsed seconds over 3 repetitions, IonStar MaxQuant peptides, all proteins with at least 2 peptides. `transform`: log2 and robust scaling on the human proteins; `aggregate`: median polish to proteins; `fit_lm`: one lm per protein; `contrasts_lm`: Wald contrasts with variance moderation; `facade_<method>`: `build_contrast_analysis()`, fit and contrasts. Timings compare only within one machine: `r paste(unique(history$tool_version[history$metric == "elapsed_s"]), collapse = ", ")`.

```{r timings, results = "asis"}
timings <- dplyr::filter(history, metric == "elapsed_s")
timings |>
  by_release("method") |>
  wide_table(caption = "Elapsed seconds per step and release.", digits = 2)
```

```{r timingsPlot, fig.height = 5}
release_plot(timings, "elapsed seconds (median of 3)")
```
